description: This file defines the 'Config' class and related nested classes within the WPEFramework plugin namespace. It includes configuration options, JSON serialization, and system path utilities, serving as a central configuration header for a plugin component.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Main configuration class for the plugin, including nested classes for root configuration and system settings.

classes.name: Config::RootConfig
classes.description: Represents the root configuration settings, including mode, locator, user, and remote address.

classes.name: Config::RootObject
classes.description: Internal class used for JSON parsing of the 'root' configuration object.

classes.name: Config::Setting
classes.description: Utility class for representing configuration settings with trace output.

methods.name: Config::DataPath
methods.description: Constructs a data path string based on the base path and class name.

methods.name: Config::PersistentPath
methods.description: Constructs a persistent storage path based on the base path and postfix or callsign.

methods.name: Config::VolatilePath
methods.description: Constructs a volatile storage path based on the base path and postfix or callsign.

methods.name: Config::IPV4UnicastNode
methods.description: Static method to retrieve the IPv4 unicast node for a given interface name.

methods.name: Config::IsSameInstance
methods.description: Checks if another Config instance refers to the same system instance based on locator and class name.
